definitions.explanation: A student who has transferred from one school to another. A common figure in Japanese school life and an extremely popular character type in anime, manga, and dramas.

examples.japanese: {転校生|てんこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{転校生|てんこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new transfer student was introduced to the class.

examples.japanese: {転校生|てんこうせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{馴染|なじ}めなかった→馴染む：14631_najimu⟧。
examples.english: The transfer student had difficulty fitting in at the new school.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{転校|てんこう}→転校：03444_tenkou⟧ (school transfer) + {生|せい} (student). Transfer students are a staple character type in Japanese fiction, often appearing as mysterious or exciting newcomers who disrupt the class dynamic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転校生|てんこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: a transfer student comes/arrives
- {転校生|てんこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to welcome a transfer student
- ⟦{転校|てんこう}する→転校する：25400_tenkousuru⟧: to transfer schools
- ⟦{転校|てんこう}→転校：03444_tenkou⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: transfer procedures
